title: Reading Drill — Counting Boats on a Canal
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Counting Boats on a Canal
passages.body:
**A** An environmental group wanted to know how often boats passed a narrow canal junction. It placed an observer by a footbridge, where vessels approaching from either direction were visible with no special equipment.

**B** The first count included boats that turned back before reaching the junction. For the second count, observers drew a clear boundary on their maps and recorded a boat only after it crossed that line.

**C** A weekend event affected the final results. The group kept its figures but labelled them separately, because they came from a day when a festival brought extra visitors to the canal.
